name: Barbell Hip Hinge Deadlift

instructions.description: Stand with the bar close to the shins and feet stable.
Hinge and bend the knees to grip the bar while keeping the trunk controlled.
Press the floor away and lift with the bar traveling close to the body.
Lower the bar by hinging first, then bending the knees as needed.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the external load used without treating it as a universal target.

commentsNotes: Technical coaching may be useful before adding substantial load.

variations.variationDescription: Barbell Hip Hinge Deadlift — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Barbell Hip Hinge Deadlift — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.
